messages:
marcus-support: Customer AcmeApp (prod key xyz) reports spikes in latency — requests intended for us-west are being routed to eu-west. They see +300-600ms and higher token costs. They insist their SDK sets region=us-west. Attaching sample headers they sent.

lisa-cs: Here's a raw request sample they provided (sanitized):
```bash
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>
X-Client-Region: us-west%2Cus-east
Content-Type: application/json

{"prompt":"hello"}
```

kai-eng: hmm — that value looks percent-encoded. Our edge header parser does exact-match on the token and does NOT URL-decode header values. So the router sees the single token `us-west%2Cus-east` which doesn't match alias `us-west` and falls back to default region routing (eu-west for this customer).

sre-oncall: I just repro'd locally by sending that exact header. Router logs: `region_lookup: no_match -> fallback: eu-west`. Confirmed fallback path.

luca-sre: edge-bot kicked off an incident ticket.

edge-bot: Created ticket EDGE-3421: "decode+normalize client region header to handle encoded separators" assigned to eng/edge.

kai-eng: Proposed remediation: 1) short-term hotfix at the edge proxy: URL-decode region header values, then split on `[,;]` and trim whitespace/quotes, map first token to region aliases. 2) Medium-term: add a validation/normalization helper in all SDKs to send a plain region token (no percent-encoding). 3) Update docs to list canonical header format.

marcus-support: I pushed the short-term mitigation to the customer (ask them to set header to `X-Client-Region: us-west` or use query `?region=us-west`). Customer replied they can toggle the header format client-side and confirmed reduced latency when sending unencoded value. :thumbsup:

kai-eng: I'll prepare a small patch (edge input filter) that decodes only the region header and runs the split/trim logic — low blast radius. If staging looks good, we can promote to prod tomorrow morning. Estimate ~2 business days for full rollout + SDK updates.

luca-sre: I'll deploy the hotfix to staging tonight (23:00 UTC) and run canaries. If green, schedule prod push 04:00 UTC tomorrow. I'll post a deploy note and rollback steps.

marcus-support: Great — I've marked the customer case with the mitigation steps and told them we'll follow up when prod change is live.

kai-eng: Follow-ups: (a) check if other headers (cookie/query) contain encoded region tokens and normalize consistently, (b) add a router metric for "region-header-decoded" to monitor how many requests require decoding.

sre-oncall: adding alert rule to watch for sudden jumps in routing fallback rate for this customer.

marcus-support: Customer very happy with the quick workaround, wants SDK pointer so their mobile team doesn't regress. I've requested SDK version (they're on mobile-sdk 2.1.4).

kai-eng: noted — I'll add a tiny change to SDK 2.1.x patch to avoid percent-encoding headers and cut a patch release.

luca-sre: Staging deploy started. Will update thread with results.

marcus-support: thanks all — keeping this open until prod hotfix + SDK patch are done.
